title: Hereditary NC Polynomials & Positivity Domains
summary: Noncommutative polynomials, elements of the free algebra generated by several noncommuting variables $x_1,...,x_g,x_1^*,...,x_g^*$, are of importance in noncommutative algebra, free analysis and real algebraic geometry. We allow matrix coefficients and view these noncommutative polynomials as functions in several size-free matrix variables. The free locus of a noncommutative polynomial $f$ is the sequence of hypersurfaces $\mathscr{Z}_n(f)=\{X\in M_n(\mathbb{C})^g:\det f(X) = 0\}$.
